attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Maryland corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Maryland Corporate Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto false result.md_has_nexus xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts); result.md_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.md_economic_nexus_threshold

action_details.action_postfix: // No nexus - no filing required false result.md_has_nexus xdef 0.0 result.md_tax_liability xdef "Maryland filing not required: No nexus with state" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Maryland state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. MD requires addback of federal interest, IRC 199A, bonus depreciation. MD allows MD municipal bond interest subtraction.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Maryland Corporate Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 result.md_state_additions xdef 0.0 result.md_state_subtractions xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Maryland state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments

action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 result.md_state_additions xdef 0.0 result.md_state_subtractions xdef "Maryland adjustments not calculated: No nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Maryland corporate income tax. Applies Maryland flat rate (8.25%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Maryland Corporate Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 result.md_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.md_tax_liability xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.md_apportioned_income is greater than 0

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Maryland corporate tax (flat rate 8.25%); Apply Maryland 8.25% flat rate
No taxable income - no tax liability
action_details.action_postfix: // No taxable income - no tax liability 0.0 result.md_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.md_tax_liability xdef result.md_estimated_payments result.md_refund_or_owed xdef "Maryland tax liability: $0 (no taxable income)" job.audit_trail swap addto

// No nexus - no tax liability 0.0 result.md_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.md_tax_liability xdef result.md_estimated_payments result.md_refund_or_owed xdef "Maryland tax liability: $0 (no nexus)" job.audit_trail swap addto
